Folks — forwarding Orion's evidence. Quick summary of initial findings from our side (I pulled the January publish logs):

- There are 6 publish batches where the same meter GUID was included twice, with different project labels. Investigation shows the exporter that runs inside our partner relay occasionally injects a secondary project label when the project is part of a shared-billing configuration. This appears to be a timing/race condition in the relayer that re-annotates the event before the second publish.
- Affected SKUs: compute.workload.orc-runner, datastore.query.batch, network.egress.gke-hop.
- Estimated duplicated usage: 1,938.7 token-hours (matches ~3% uplift reported).

Recommendation / immediate actions:
1) Pause the relayer job that re-annotates project labels for the shared-billing pipeline (I triggered a hotfix to pause the re-annotator; it's currently off).
2) Prepare a credit memo for Orion for the duplicated lines and coordinate with GCP Marketplace billing to apply the credit to INV-20270184.
3) Patch: deploy a fix to the relayer to make the label enrichment idempotent and add a dedupe check for pubsub_id.

Marissa / Soojin — can you confirm we can issue a vendor-side credit memo and whether finance needs any formal request from Orion? Jared — please confirm whether Orion is comfortable with Redwood issuing a vendor credit (Redwood-issued credit ledger entry) and we will coordinate the Marketplace-side adjustment.

Thanks,
Karthik
